description: Cabin museum of the Zabaykalsky Krai Museum of Aviation and Cosmonautics. Flown in from Chita-Kadala and opened in August 2020; gutted by an electrical fire on 25 December 2023 and under volunteer restoration since May 2024. c/n 78A280.
Second Tu-154 on the Raduga zoo site. c/n 81A506.
Added to the site in January 2024. c/n 533411024.
